app.name: Gekko2 SPEED BETA12.22 GS/GX
app.long_description: Experimental PS2 emulator for Wii. Separate saved cold-boot switches for native 128-bit JIT chain residency and experimental PSM conversion; both default OFF. Audited ALU/MMI, LQ/SQ, LD/SD and integer-branch native companions. All 13 GS texture inputs decoded to GX RGBA8; four color scanout formats; bounded CT16/16S hybrid rendering. XGKICK live-tag, IPU precision and safe GX fault pause fixes. No confirmed Wii gameplay, speedup, Crash black-screen or BIOS-tile fix. Bring your own legal BIOS and disc image.
